name: Midiverb
author: charlesvestal
summary: Alesis Midiverb, Midifex and Midiverb II emulator, running the units' own programs on a cycle-accurate DASP interpreter at 23.4 kHz. Needs your own EPROM dumps: no ROMs are included - put midiverb.rom, midifex.rom and midiverb2.rom in the plugin's roms folder; a unit without its ROM passes audio through.
